session_summary: Fixed Mixed Content issues by forcing HTTPS on API calls when the client is secure.
technical_details: Updated `services/ServerBridge.ts` to upgrade HTTP URLs to HTTPS in the constructor if `window.location.protocol` is 'https:'. Updated `hooks/useAppAuth.ts` to enforce HTTPS on stored `serverUrl`. Updated `components/ServerStatusPanel.tsx` to prevent auto-fill from downgrading HTTPS to HTTP.
